answer.bar: Desktop: Edit, Align Vertically, Pin, Duplicate, Remove, lefts 108.1, 144.1, 184.1, 229.1, 269.1. Phone, second of two: Edit, Align Vertically, Pin, Move Up, Move Down, Remove, lefts 1041, 1077, 1117, 1157, 1197, 1242.
answer.menu: A press on a value keeps the menu open; a press on Align Vertically closes it.
answer.views: Align Bottom on desktop leaves the phone at Center (the phone read before its own press), and the rule is written per view.
answer.barBox: The bar is 205 by 42 inside a 207 by 44 halo, as read by the boxes of the Edit button and its parents.
